content.title: Kentucky Women's Basketball Transfer Tracker - WBB Blog
content.text: Kentucky Women’s Basketball Transfer Tracker: Current and Recent Years This Kentucky women’s basketball transfer tracker covers transfer portal activity and transfers in and out for the current year, plus a rundown of transfers in and out going back to 2019-20. Each year runs from August to July (based on NCAA convention), so the 2025-26 transfer cycle runs from August 2025 through July 2026. Players who entered the transfer portal but ended up not transferring are listed after the out-transfers. Kenny Brooks (2nd season in 2025-26) was named the women’s basketball head coach at Kentucky (member of the SEC) in March 2024. Kyra Elzy served as the Wildcats head coach from the 2020-21 through the 2023-24 seasons, having succeeded Matthew Mitchell. See WBB Blog’s main Kentucky page for comprehensive coverage of Wildcats women’s basketball recruiting, including a scholarship chart showing the current roster configuration and projections of the rosters for future seasons and indications of open scholarship spots. 2025-26 Transfers In [none] Transfers Out [none] 2024-25 Transfers In • Asia Boone, 5-8 SO shooting guard, San Diego, CA / Liberty
